raw.details:
Hack Celestia  — International Hackathon

Innovate. Collaborate. Build the Future.

About Hack Celestia:

Hack Celestia is an international hackathon that brings together innovative minds, creative thinkers, and technology enthusiasts to collaborate on ideas and build impactful solutions to real-world challenges.

The hackathon encourages participants to explore emerging technologies, develop practical solutions, and transform their ideas into meaningful projects. It provides a platform for participants to showcase their technical skills, creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.

Whether you are passionate about artificial intelligence, software development, sustainability, education, or other technology-driven domains, Hack Celestia is an opportunity to challenge yourself, learn, innovate, and create something meaningful.

Who Can Participate?

  • Hack Celestia welcomes eligible female participants interested in technology, innovation, coding, and problem-solving from across the world, subject to the official eligibility criteria.

Important: Participation is exclusively open to female participants.

  • Participants should be enthusiastic about learning, collaborating, and developing innovative technological solutions.
  • Team Formation Guidelines
  • Teams may consist of up to 5 members, subject to the official team rules.
  • Participants must meet the eligibility requirements.
  • Teams should provide accurate details of all their members during registration.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration and diverse perspectives are encouraged.

How to Participate

  • Complete the official Hack Celestia registration form.
  • Enter your team name and select the relevant track.
  • Provide a brief description of your proposed idea and solution.
  • Enter the required details of your team members.
  • Submit your registration before the deadline.

Project Development and Submission

Participants are encouraged to develop innovative, feasible, and impactful solutions to relevant real-world problems.

Projects should demonstrate:

  • Creativity and originality.
  • Effective use of technology.
  • Practical implementation and feasibility.
  • Clear problem identification and solution design.
  • Potential impact and usefulness.

Detailed problem statements, submission requirements, and any additional instructions will be shared by the organizing team, wherever applicable.

Evaluation and Shortlisting

Projects and submissions may be evaluated on innovation, technical implementation, creativity, feasibility, problem-solving approach, and potential impact, according to the official judging criteria.

Shortlisted teams will be informed about subsequent stages and any additional requirements by the organizing team.

Important Date

Registration Deadline: 31 October 2026

Interested participants are encouraged to register before the deadline and ensure that all required information is submitted correctly.

Why Participate in Hack Celestia?

  • Be part of an international hackathon community.
  • Collaborate with fellow innovators and technology enthusiasts.
  • Apply your technical knowledge to real-world challenges.
  • Strengthen your coding, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • Build innovative projects and showcase your creativity.

Please review the eligibility criteria and registration requirements before submitting your application.

Hack Celestia — Where brainpower meets bold initiations
